data.description: Offering unparalleled luxury living with exclusive waterfront residences and world-class amenities.

data.answer:
The District One developer is Meydan Sobha. Enjoy a healthy and stress-free living in District One Meydan. The green neighborhood has a jogging and cycling track with state-of-the-art gyms and fitness centers. The family- and child-friendly residential development also has nurseries and kid's play areas.

The community's strategic location offers seamless connectivity to Dubai's key attractions, making it an ideal sanctuary for those seeking a harmonious blend of tranquility and urban sophistication.

This prestigious community features a collection of grand villas, mansions, and waterfront residences, each designed with meticulous attention to detail and modern aesthetics.

Azizi Riviera by Azizi Developments is a prominent project that comprises a collection of apartment buildings featuring 69 mid-rise residential towers. The complexes offer a variety of living spaces, including studios, 1 to 3-bedroom units, and penthouses available for both rent and sale.

Orb Tower is also one of the District One residences, featuring 1 – 4 bedroom apartments. Meanwhile, Seagull Point Tower features contemporary 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, all offering stunning views of the glistening Crystal Lagoon.

With a choice of 7, 7+, or 8 bedrooms, the exquisite mansions in District One designs take inspiration from three distinctive architectural styles: modern Arabic, Medditerian, and District One Contemporary villas. Moreover, the 4—to 6-bedroom District One Dubai villas comprise various amenities like lawns, a swimming pool, and a fitness center.

Off-Plan Projects in District One

Looking for off-plan properties in Dubai? Lagoon Views is one of the newly launched District One residences, offering exclusively designed 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, penthouses, and lagoon District One villas. This leisure-oriented project features a high-rise, 22-storey tower complemented by ground-level leisure areas and beachside attractions right at its doorstep. Other upcoming properties in the area include:

  • District One Residences Meydan 6
  • District One Residences 8
  • District One Residences 11
  • District One Residences 12
  • District One Residences 14
  • District One Residences 15
  • District One Residences 16

Buying a Property in District One

There are various properties for purchase in District One. The price for a studio starts from AED 300k and can go up to AED 2.3M. A 1BHK unit requires a minimum investment of AED 348k, while you can buy an apartment in District One featuring 2 bedrooms at just over AED 1M. The price for a 3-bedroom flat ranges from AED 1.3M to AED 7.2M.

Penthouses, available in 3 to 6-bedroom configurations, have a starting price of approximately AED 14.4M. Additionally, shops in Meydan One are available for sale, with prices ranging from AED 499.9k to AED 51M, depending on the building and gross area. You can compare the prices of District One villas for sale with those of other properties for sale in MBR City.

Rental Properties in District One Meydan

Searching for properties for rent in District One. Renting a studio apartment in Meydan One requires a minimum annual payment of AED 36k. For a 1-bedroom unit, the starting rent is AED 52k per year. The annual rents for 2-bedroom flats range between AED 79.9k and AED 130k, while 3-bedroom rental units can go up to AED 160k. For commercial properties, rents for shops in Meydan One vary between AED 99.9k and AED 799.9k, depending on the gross area and additional benefits.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in District One Meydan?

data.answer:
The community is thoughtfully designed to offer a harmonious living environment, with lush green spaces, extensive cycling and jogging tracks, and easy access to top-tier amenities such as high-end retail outlets, gourmet dining options, and exclusive leisure facilities. Its prime location ensures seamless connectivity to major landmarks and business hubs in Dubai, making it a highly desirable address for discerning homeowners. District One's commitment to luxury, privacy, and convenience makes it an unparalleled choice for those seeking a sophisticated lifestyle in the heart of the city

Public Transportation in District One Meydan

Public transportation in District One, Meydan, offers residents convenient options to navigate the city. The community is well-serviced by several bus routes that connect to key areas of Dubai. Moreover, the Business Bay Metro Station, located about a 10-minute drive away, provides easy access to the wider metro network, ensuring seamless travel to major business and leisure destinations. Taxis and ride-hailing services are also readily available, offering further flexibility for commuting.

Supermarkets in District One Meydan

Residents of District One Dubai, have access to a variety of supermarkets catering to their daily needs. Spinneys and Carrefour are the primary supermarkets located within a 10-minute drive, providing a wide range of groceries, fresh produce, and household items. For more specialized shopping, the nearby Dubai Mall offers an array of gourmet food stores and international brands, all within a 15-minute drive from the community.

Shopping Malls in and Near District One Meydan Area

Shopping enthusiasts in District One, Meydan, can enjoy the proximity to several prominent malls. The Meydan One Mall, currently under development, will be a major retail and entertainment destination just minutes away. 

Similarly, Dubai Mall, one of the world's largest shopping centers, is a 15-minute drive from District One, offering an extensive selection of luxury brands, dining options, and entertainment facilities. Another nearby option is the Mall of the Emirates, approximately 20 minutes away by car, featuring a wide range of retail outlets, restaurants, and the famous indoor ski slope, Ski Dubai.

Schools and Nurseries in District One Meydan

District One Meydan offers a range of reputable educational institutions to cater to families with children of all ages. Within a short driving distance, parents can find several esteemed nurseries and schools. Hartland International School and North London Collegiate School, both about 10 minutes away, provide top-tier education with international curricula. 

The nearby GEMS Wellington Academy and Repton School Dubai, approximately 15 minutes away, offer excellent educational programs from early years to high school, ensuring that children receive a quality education close to home.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near District One Dubai

The community features several mosques, including the Meydan Mosque, providing convenient access for daily prayers and religious gatherings. For residents seeking other places of worship, St. Mary's Catholic Church and Holy Trinity Church are located about 20 minutes away in Oud Metha. The Sikh Gurudwara and Hindu Temple in Bur Dubai, approximately a 25-minute drive, offer services and facilities for the Hindu and Sikh communities, ensuring everyone can practice their faith comfortably.

Clinics and Hospitals Near District One Meydan Area

Healthcare facilities near District One Meydan are readily accessible, providing high-quality medical services for residents. Emirates Hospital Clinic, located within a 10-minute drive, offers a wide range of outpatient services and specialist consultations. 

For more comprehensive medical care, the renowned Mediclinic City Hospital in Dubai Healthcare City is about 15 minutes away, equipped with advanced medical technology and a team of expert healthcare professionals. Additionally, the Latifa Hospital for Women and Children, also around 15 minutes away, provides specialized care for mothers and children, ensuring comprehensive healthcare solutions close to home.

District One Meydan Location & Nearby Areas

District One Meydan is strategically located in the heart of Dubai, offering easy access to various key areas and attractions. The community is situated just minutes away from Downtown Dubai, home to the iconic Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, making it an ideal location for those seeking proximity to the city's bustling center. Business Bay, a major commercial hub, is also nearby, providing convenient access to business and financial districts.

Moreover, the area is well-connected to major highways, including Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, facilitating smooth travel to other parts of the city. The serene Meydan Racecourse and the upcoming Meydan One Mall are also nearby, enhancing the overall lifestyle experience for residents of District One Meydan.

more_info.question: Things to Do in District One Meydan

data.answer:
District One Meydan offers a plethora of activities and attractions that cater to diverse interests, ensuring residents and visitors always have something exciting to do. One of the main highlights is the Crystal Lagoon, the world's largest man-made lagoon, where you can indulge in various water activities such as kayaking, paddleboarding, and swimming, all while enjoying the stunning waterfront views.

Restaurants in District One Meydan

District One Meydan offers a variety of dining options that cater to different tastes and preferences. Residents and visitors can enjoy a range of culinary experiences, from casual eateries to fine dining establishments. 

The Meydan One Mall, once completed, will feature an array of restaurants offering diverse cuisines from around the world. For now, nearby dining options include the Meydan Hotel, which houses several restaurants such as Prime Steakhouse, offering premium cuts of meat, and Shiba, serving delicious Asian cuisine. Additionally, the District One community itself is home to charming cafes and eateries where residents can enjoy a relaxed meal or a quick coffee.

Beaches Near District One Meydan

While District One Meydan is not directly on the coastline, residents have convenient access to several of Dubai’s stunning beaches. Jumeirah Beach, one of the most popular beaches in Dubai, is about a 20-minute drive away and offers pristine sands, clear waters, and a range of water sports activities. 

Another excellent option is Kite Beach, approximately 25 minutes away by car, known for its vibrant atmosphere, food trucks, and kite surfing. For a more exclusive beach experience, residents can visit La Mer, a trendy beachfront destination about 20 minutes away, offering chic boutiques, restaurants, and leisure activities.

Hotels in District One Meydan

District One Meydan boasts several luxurious hotel options that provide exceptional accommodation and services. The Meydan Hotel is a prominent five-star hotel located within the area, renowned for its elegant rooms and suites, world-class dining, and panoramic views of the Meydan Racecourse. It also offers a range of leisure facilities, including a rooftop infinity pool, a spa, and a golf course. Another notable hotel is the Al Habtoor Polo Resort, which is a short drive away and offers a unique equestrian-themed experience with upscale accommodations and polo fields. These hotels, along with future developments in Meydan One, ensure that guests enjoy a comfortable and memorable stay in the heart of Dubai.

Attractions and Landmarks Near District One Dubai

District One Meydan is conveniently located near some of Dubai’s most iconic attractions and landmarks. Just a short drive away is Downtown Dubai, home to the world-renowned Burj Khalifa, the tallest building in the world, and the Dubai Mall, one of the largest shopping and entertainment destinations globally. 

The Dubai Opera, located in the same area, offers a variety of cultural performances, including operas, ballets, and concerts. Additionally, the Meydan Racecourse, known for hosting the prestigious Dubai World Cup, is right at the doorstep of District One, providing thrilling equestrian events. For a touch of greenery and tranquility, the nearby Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary offers a unique escape into nature with its diverse birdlife and serene surroundings.

Outdoor Activities, Salons, and Gyms

District One Dubai provides ample opportunities for outdoor activities and wellness. The community features extensive jogging tracks and a District One cycle track, perfect for those who enjoy staying active in a scenic environment. The Crystal Lagoon offers a variety of water activities, such as kayaking, paddleboarding, and swimming. 

For relaxation and personal care, residents can visit the numerous salons and spas within the area, offering a range of beauty and wellness treatments. Gyms equipped with state-of-the-art fitness equipment are also available, ensuring that residents have access to comprehensive fitness facilities. Nearby, the Nad Al Sheba Park offers additional outdoor spaces for sports and leisure activities.

When considering living in or visiting District One Meydan, it’s essential to factor in the ongoing development in the area. While many amenities and facilities are already available, some parts of the community, such as the Meydan One Mall, are still under construction, which might affect the overall experience temporarily.

What types of properties are available in District One Meydan? 

The community features a range of properties, including 1 to 3-bedroom apartments, 7 to 8-bedroom mansions, and exclusive waterfront homes. Penthouses and commercial properties like shops are also available.

What are the main attractions near District One Meydan? 

Nearby attractions include the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, Dubai Opera, Meydan Racecourse, and the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. The upcoming Meydan One Mall will also be a major attraction.

What amenities are available within District One Meydan? 

District One Meydan offers extensive amenities such as the Crystal Lagoon for water activities, cycling and jogging tracks, gyms, communal swimming pools, retail shops, and high-end dining options.

How is the connectivity and transportation in District One Meydan? 

The community is well-connected to major highways like Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, providing easy access to other parts of Dubai. Public transportation options include nearby bus routes and the Business Bay Metro Station, which is about a 10-minute drive away.

data.content:
District One Dubai is a mixed-use gated community in Dubai featuring lush green spaces, pedestrian-friendly pathways, and a sustainable urban environment.

District One Dubai is part of the Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR) community along Al Meydan Road. It houses residential properties, including mansions, villas, signature plots, and water-facing apartments.

Crystal Lagoon is the area's centerpiece, offering exclusive waterfront living in the heart of the city. Moreover, it offers various office spaces, recreational opportunities, and hospitality options.
